contexts.text: Egypt is here called the corner stone of the tribes, as it should serve for a support to the things of faith.
His righteousness it supported Him ().
Support ye your heart () = as much as is meet. Explained.
Bone = the ultimate in which interior things are terminated... that they may be supported...
For that stone supported Moses.
To destroy truths from the Divine which are the last in order... by which are supported the interior truths and goods. Signified.
The fascia alba, which is a support to the muscles of the abdomen. SE 3245.
The literal sense is the basis and support on which the spiritual sense rests.
The ultimate is as it were the support to the interiors...
The ultimate of truth Divine... upon which as upon a support and foundation, interior things subsist and rest.
That which in Heaven encompasses, founds... for it is that which terminates, encloses and contains, consequently which supports and sustains.
Therefore the simultaneous things, which are the ultimates, serve the successive ones as corresponding Supports on which they rest.
For internal things rest upon externa! ones as upon their Supports; and the Supports are truths. Explained.
Unless the flesh and bones were in the place of bases or Supports, man could not subsist. Explained.
Every word (in the sense of the letter) is a containant and support. TCR 226. AE 1085:2.
Unless the understanding can support it by some lesson...
For God was then most present in His inmosts, and supported Him.
So that places and material things are the Supports on which (the Spirits) stand.
When good works were taken away, the Supports on which they were standing were taken away.
Thus they would also take away from Heaven its support.
They could serve the infernal crew as a support.
To support by the truths upon which the Church is founded. Signified.
Suffulcire, occurs.
As the Word in the letter is such, it is as it were a support for Heaven...
Fulcire occurs.
The Word, to which the sense of its letter serves as a support and basis. Explained.
Through this New Church the Lord... supports Heaven.
